about_the_game:
Barbarian Lands is a challenge hardcore, single-player ARPG set in a barbarian open world. The game features fast-paced combat with a lot of different weapons, exploration to find anything, an unique risk/reward progression system where players lose experience upon death. Players take on the role of a barbarian who is going to fight as a mercenary in a bloody war on the north, on the way though, the barbarian finds a village where the inhabitants are going through a macabre situation. The villagers talk about the Vizimir's forge, a strange place constructed by a dark wizard with the power to create new species, he is taking people and mixing them with animals and other beings, creating grotesque hybrid creatures that are increasingly powerful and horrendous. Monsters of all kinds surround the village and the desperate inhabitants offer what they have to the barbarian to protect then and bring back their people. At least those who are still humans.

The strange Vizimir’s experiments will just became more and more grotesque.

Hardcore RPG:

Barbarian Lands provides a challenging experience, each enemy found can be a battle for life.

Lose XP upon death:

When you die, you lose part of the experience you acquired. Gaining levels is not easy and requires risk.

Hidden Equipment:

The best equipments and weapons in Barbarian Lands are not easily found. It is necessary to explore the most dangerous areas.

Different ways to play:

There are different possible play styles and strategies, allowing you to choose different classes and weapons to use.
